blocks.text: Saalon se jandaron (organisms) ko kingdoms mein baantne ke kai nizam (systems) pesh kiye gaye hain. Robert H. Whittaker ka five-kingdom system, jo aap ne Chapter 1 mein parha, tamam prokaryotes ko ek alag kingdom, Monera, mein rakhta tha. Pichhle dus saalon mein molecular studies ne us nizam mein sangeen (serious) khamiyan (flaws) dikhai hain, aur aksar biologists ab three-domain system ko tarjeeh (preference) dete hain jo molecular data se behtar milta hai. Bacteria woh prokaryotes hain jo apni alag domain, domain Bacteria, mein rakhe gaye hain. Is chapter mein hum bacterial cell ki tafseeli (detailed) banawat (structure) aur bacteria ki ahmiyat (importance) parhenge.

blocks.title: Yaad dahani
blocks.text: Robert H. Whittaker ne zindagi ki paanch kingdoms pesh kin: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Pehli mein prokaryotes aate hain; baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

Bacteria ek mutanawwa (diverse) group hain, aur sab ki organisation unicellular prokaryotic hai: in mein membrane-bounded organelles nahin hote, aur ek wazeh (well-defined) nucleus bhi nahin hota. In ki cellular organisation sab se saada (simplest) hai.

blocks.alt: Ek rod-shaped bacterial cell lambai mein khula hua. Bahar se andar: capsule, cell wall, cell membrane, phir cytoplasm jis mein ribosomes, ek plasmid ring, mesosome ki tehain aur nucleoid apne circular DNA ke saath. Ek pole se flagellum nikal raha hai aur satah se chhote pili.
blocks.caption: Ek aam bacterium ki banawat (Figure 2.1 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Bahar ki tehain teen lakeeron mein hain: sab se bahar dheela capsule, phir sakht cell wall, aur us ke andar patli cell membrane. Cytoplasm mein nucleoid markaz (centre) ke qareeb uljha hua circular DNA hai; chhote nuqtay ribosomes hain; ek chhota daira plasmid hai; membrane ki tehain mesosomes hain. Ek lamba lehrdaar flagellum cell ke ek sire se nikalta hai; kai chhote pili satah se bahar nikle hain.

blocks.text: Cell wall bacterial cell ki plasma membrane ke gird ek sakht (rigid) deewar hai. Is ka bara hissa ek khaas macromolecule hai jise peptidoglycan ya murein kehte hain. Peptidoglycan lambi glycan (polysaccharide) chains se banta hai jo chhote peptide tukron se cross-link hoti hain. Mukhtalif bacteria mein is ki miqdaar (amount) alag hoti hai. Cell wall mein lipids bhi hote hain jo peptidoglycan se jure hote hain.

Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria mein wall ki tarkeeb (composition) kaafi mukhtalif hoti hai. Gram-positive bacteria ki wall mein peptidoglycan ki moti teh hoti hai aur lipid kam hota hai. Gram-negative bacteria ki wall mein peptidoglycan ki patli teh hoti hai, aur us ke upar lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki ek outer membrane hoti hai. Yehi outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko kai antibiotics ke khilaf muzahimat (resistance) deti hai. Is mein porin naam ka protein hota hai jo khaas molecules ke liye ek pore (soorakh) ki tarah kaam karta hai. Gram-negative bacteria mein periplasmic space (peptidoglycan teh aur cell membrane ke darmiyan ki jagah) bhi Gram-positive se zyada hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do walls ke cross-sections saath saath. Gram-positive: cell membrane ke upar peptidoglycan ki moti teh. Gram-negative: lipopolysaccharide aur porin channels wali outer membrane, chauri periplasmic space jis mein patli peptidoglycan teh, phir cell membrane.
blocks.caption: Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria ki cell wall ki tarkeeb (Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Baen taraf Gram-positive wall: moti jamuni peptidoglycan patti seedhi cell membrane par baithi hai, periplasmic gap bohat tang hai. Daen taraf Gram-negative wall: lipopolysaccharide se bhari outer membrane jis mein porin channels hain, chauri periplasmic space, patli peptidoglycan teh, aur neeche cell membrane.

blocks.title: Gram's staining
blocks.text: Sir Hans Christian Gram ne Gram's staining ki technique banai. Gram-positive bacteria jamuni (purple) rang lete hain kyunke woh violet dye ko rok lete hain. Gram-negative bacteria violet dye nahin rokte, is liye woh counterstain ke asal rang mein nazar aate hain.

blocks.text: Kuch bacteria apni cell wall ke bahar capsule banate hain. Yeh ek jelly jaisi (gelatinous) teh hai jo bacterial colonies ko chipchipa (sticky) kirdar deti hai.

Cell membrane, ya plasma membrane, cell wall ke bilkul neeche hoti hai. Jin bacteria mein cell wall nahin hoti (jaise mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas) un mein yehi sab se bahar wali teh hoti hai. Bacterial cell membrane ki kimiyai (chemical) banawat mein sterols (jaise cholesterol) nahin hote. Kuch jagahon par membrane andar ki taraf murti (invaginates) hai aur cytoplasm mein vesicles, tubules ya lamellae banati hai. In banawaton ko mesosomes kehte hain. Yeh DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa lete hain aur respiratory centres ka kaam bhi karte hain.

blocks.title: Mesosomes
blocks.text: Bacterial cell membrane ki andar ki taraf tehain jo cytoplasm mein vesicles, tubules ya lamellae banati hain. Yeh DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa leti hain aur respiratory centres ka kaam karti hain; isi liye bacterium mitochondria ke baghair bhi respiration kar leta hai.

Cytoplasm mein hal shuda (dissolved) maddey (substances) aur bari banawatein hoti hain jaise nucleoid, ribosomes aur mesosomes. Is mein cytoskeleton aur membrane-bounded organelles nahin hote. Bohat se ribosomes cytoplasmic matrix mein azaadana bikhre hote hain aur kuch plasma membrane se dheele jure hote hain. Bacterial ribosomes eukaryotic ribosomes se chhote hote hain: har ribosome 70S par sediment hota hai, jis mein bara subunit 50S aur chhota subunit 30S hai.

Cytoplasm ke markaz ke qareeb ek be-tarteeb shakal ka ghana (dense) ilaqa hota hai, nucleoid, jis mein DNA hota hai. Bacterium ke paas ek hi, circular, double-stranded DNA molecule hota hai jis se histones jure nahin hote. Ise kabhi kabhi bacterium ka chromosome kehte hain.

Kuch bacteria ke paas chhote circular, double-stranded, extra-chromosomal DNA molecules bhi hote hain jinhen plasmids kehte hain. Plasmids khud replicate karte hain aur cell division se pehle ya baad mein replicate kar sakte hain. In mein aise genes hote hain jo bacteria ko na-mawafiq (unfavourable) halaat, jaise antibiotics, ke khilaf muzahimat dete hain. Plasmids genetic engineering mein aham vectors ka kaam bhi karte hain: in ke zariye chune hue genes bacteria mein pohanchaye jate hain, cloning ke liye ya khaas proteins banane ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Outer membrane Gram-negative bacteria ko kai antibiotics ke khilaf muzahimat kyun deti hai, aur phir khaas molecules us se guzarte kaise hain?
blocks.explanation: Lipopolysaccharides aur lipoproteins ki outer membrane patli peptidoglycan teh ke bahar ek extra rukawat (barrier) hai, is liye kai antibiotics apne nishane tak nahin pohanch paate. Us membrane mein porin proteins khaas molecules ke liye pores ka kaam karte hain.

items: Bacteria unicellular prokaryotes hain: membrane-bounded organelles nahin, wazeh nucleus nahin.
Cell wall peptidoglycan (murein) ki hai: Gram-positive mein moti, Gram-negative mein patli aur upar outer membrane (lipopolysaccharides, lipoproteins, porins).
Kuch bacteria wall ke bahar jelly jaisa capsule banate hain.
Cell membrane mein sterols nahin; us ki tehain, mesosomes, DNA replication, cell division aur respiration mein madad karti hain.

Cytoplasm mein 70S ribosomes, nucleoid mein ek circular double-stranded DNA histones ke baghair, aur kuch bacteria mein plasmids jo muzahimat ke genes rakhte hain aur genetic engineering mein vectors bante hain.
